# ActiveLoom Documentation Index for Coding Agents

> Reusable engineering workflows, adversarial review protocols, commit-pinned review ledgers, bounded automation, and herd orchestration for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.

Use this index to load only the specific workflow or reference needed for your current task. For full context ingestion in one request, fetch https://activeloom.dev/llms-full.txt.

## Agent Entry Guide

- [Agent Entry Guide](https://activeloom.dev/agent-guide.md): Copyable session prompt, task-to-skill selector, prerequisites, and source ownership map.
- [Everyday Workflows](https://github.com/loomantix/activeloom/blob/main/docs/workflows.md): How `issues`, `diagnosing-bugs`, `backlog-refinement`, `grill`, `product-grill`, `agent-loop`, `critique`, `deepcritique`, and the automatic review chain are started and hand off to each other.
- [Set Up for Autonomous Development](https://github.com/loomantix/activeloom/blob/main/docs/autonomous-development.md): Stage-by-stage setup from install to a first allowlisted `agent-loop` run.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/loomantix/activeloom): Upstream source repository (Apache 2.0).

## Core Engineering Skills

- [grill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/grill/SKILL.md): Relentless pre-code interview that stress-tests a plan or design until nothing is silently assumed.
- [product-grill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/product-grill/SKILL.md): Product interview that stress-tests a plan from the user's point of view; can conclude don't build.
- [diagnosing-bugs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md): Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and regressions: isolate, repro, RCA, minimal verified fix.
- [feature-dev](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/feature-dev/SKILL.md): Guided feature development with codebase understanding and architecture focus.
- [issues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/issues/SKILL.md): Work an issue end to end (scope check, claim, worktree, implement, draft PR); ready queue with dependency resolution.
- [backlog-refinement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/backlog-refinement/SKILL.md): Prepare a GitHub backlog for autonomous work: assess, prioritize, and rewrite issues into agent-ready form.
- [agent-loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.codex/skills/agent-loop/SKILL.md): Autonomous issue implementation loop with strict allowlisting, one linked worktree and draft PR per issue, and bounded local review.
- [handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md): Write or resume a session handoff comment on a GitHub issue.

## Review Skills

- [critique](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/critique/SKILL.md): PR-first adversarial review. Posts verified findings inline before fixing. Lean mode (highest-signal lenses) vs Deep mode (full relevant review matrix).
- [deepcritique](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/deepcritique/SKILL.md): High-fidelity review chain for changes whose tier resolves to Deep.
- [red-team](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/red-team/SKILL.md): Pre-merge red team of a reviewed PR: how the change fails once live, sorted into fix-before-merge, follow-up issue, or accepted risk.
- [review-setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/review-setup/SKILL.md): Set reviewer and worker model/effort pairs and local review engine order.

## Herd Orchestration (herdr)

One agent session drives other agent sessions in visible [herdr](https://herdr.dev) panes. Requires herdr 0.9.0+, the Codex harness installed, the review profile, and an authenticated `gh`. Guide: [Herd orchestration](https://github.com/loomantix/activeloom/blob/main/docs/herd-orchestration.md).

- [horch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/horch/SKILL.md): Workspace orchestrator: starts review chains, builds, grills, and promotions in tabs; ships converged work only to the integration branch.
- [hreview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/hreview/SKILL.md): Runs the ordinary review chain on a PR, one engine per pane, until it converges or runs out of rounds. Never merges.
- [hgrill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/hgrill/SKILL.md): Grills an issue on each configured engine in turn, then posts product calls and assumptions for a human check.
- [hloop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/hloop/SKILL.md): Batch loop: a build tab per agent-ready issue, then a fresh review chain, then a ship through horch's gate.
- [hred-team](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/hred-team/SKILL.md): Red-teams a reviewed PR in a read-only pane; blocker and high findings are fixed on the PR, the rest become issues.
- [hpromote](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/hpromote/SKILL.md): Runs the repository's promotion recipe across visible panes; stops at the human approval and merge.
- [auto-glance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/skills/auto-glance/SKILL.md): One non-author model stands in for the human glance on small or docs-only PRs. Opt-in per repository.

## Review Protocols & Ledgers

- [Review Workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.codex/REVIEW_WORKFLOW.md): Canonical PR-first review lifecycle, review tiers (Lean vs Deep), and multi-engine convergence.
- [Review Ledger Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.claude/references/local-review-ledger.md): Engine-neutral contract. The draft PR is the ledger: roster and attestation markers carry sha256 digests and name the exact head commit they cover. Evidence, not a merge gate.

## CLI & Installation

- CLI commands:
  - `npx activeloom init --harness claude --harness codex --harness gemini`: Write the selected harness trees into this repository (`--harness` is repeatable; omit it to use detection).
  - `npx activeloom add <skill> --harness <id>`: Install a skill for yourself (Tier 0). For example, `npx activeloom add hreview horch --harness claude` installs those herd skills with their required skills.
  - `npx activeloom init --sync`: Add a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that proposes updates via PRs (Tier 2). `--sync --app` uses a GitHub App for signed commits (Tier 3).
- Requirements: Node 18.17+ for the CLI; `init` also needs Python 3.9+ with PyYAML.
